description.text: We help people turn ideas into startups, startups into companies, and companies into global impact. Based in Montreal. Apply to District 3 today.

targetApplicants.text: Our support is aimed at all entrepreneurs using new technologies to innovate. District 3 offers expertise in specific sectors. Do you work in biotech, healthcare or social innovation? We can offer you support and resources specific to your sector.
